verdict.rationale: Windmill's own docs describe an MCP integration that lets Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client connect to Windmill and trigger scripts and flows, and a probe confirms a dedicated official MCP docs page. missing for 10: details on setup/auth scoping and the exposed tool surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: With MCP, you can connect your favorite LLMs (like Claude, Cursor, or any MCP compatible client) to Windmill, allowing you to trigger your scripts and flows from your client chat.
